baseline.parser: sqlite3-parser@0.7.1 using its SQLite 3.53.0 grammar export
baseline.parserRuntimeReason: The compiler grammar is one release behind the runtime. A checked-in fail-closed differential corpus covers every classified statement, query/expression, and function family, malformed input, parameter/result behavior, and runtime-newer generic function syntax.

reasonCatalog.implemented: Implemented end to end in the signed SQL protocol, compiler, profiled executor, and result envelope.
reasonCatalog.profile_identity: Safe only under the exact parser, SQLite/DoltLite engine digest, startup controls, and canonical value profile.
reasonCatalog.canonical_lowering: Chronolog adds or applies deterministic canonicalization without changing the signed SQL source.
reasonCatalog.determinism_conformance: The SQLite construct is valid but remains gated until row choice, representative choice, effects, replay, and error behavior are proven deterministic.
reasonCatalog.registered_extension: The construct requires a signed immutable implementation identity, resource contract, and replay conformance.
reasonCatalog.ambient_state: The construct can consult time, randomness, connection history, filesystem, process, or mutable engine state.
reasonCatalog.transaction_control: The candidate reducer owns the transaction and savepoint boundary.
reasonCatalog.protected_state: The construct can access Chronolog or Dolt control state outside the public transaction log and approved SQLite catalog.
reasonCatalog.physical_storage: The result or effect depends on physical pages, WAL, caches, attachment, TEMP state, or allocator state.
reasonCatalog.maintenance_gate: Planner statistics or physical maintenance effects need feature-specific replay conformance.
reasonCatalog.engine_option_absent: The pinned engine was not compiled with the optional SQLite feature.
reasonCatalog.parser_version_skew: The parser grammar is one SQLite release behind the pinned runtime.

AlterTableStmt.current: Executes sequentially against the candidate prefix catalog.

CreateIndexStmt.current: Executes sequentially and is visible to following statements.

CreateTableStmt.current: Ordinary SQLite columns, constraints, dynamic typing, STRICT, rowid, WITHOUT ROWID, and autoincrement are streamed DDL.

CreateTableAsSelect.current: Admitted when the SELECT has a syntactic at-most-one-row proof (no FROM or one VALUES row); broader row-producing forms fail closed with SQL_CREATE_TABLE_AS_SELECT_TEMPORARILY_GATED.

CreateTriggerStmt.current: Nested trigger bodies are parsed and validated; RAISE remains gated.

CreateViewStmt.current: View bodies are parsed and validated recursively.

DeleteStmt.current: Exact SQL executes with bounded multiset RETURNING; the proven ordered target-key subset uses private frozen identities.

InsertValues.current: Authored VALUES order, conflict clauses, and bounded multiset RETURNING are supported.

InsertSelect.current: Admitted when the SELECT has a syntactic at-most-one-row proof; multirow SELECT inputs remain gated pending a catalog-aware input-order and conflict proof.

PragmaStmt.current: Only the read-only catalog allowlist below is admitted.

SelectStmt.current: Preconditions, observations, local queries, and bounded body results are supported subject to the feature gates below.

UpdateStmt.current: Exact ordinary UPDATE and bounded multiset RETURNING are supported.

UpdateFromOrConflict.current: UPDATE FROM is admitted only for one derived source with a syntactic at-most-one-row proof. Default/OR ABORT updates are admitted; order-sensitive conflict modes and multirow source choices remain gated.

UpdateDeleteOrderLimit.current: The compiler parses the authored extension independently of the native SQLite option, selects a bounded rowid or complete WITHOUT ROWID primary-key vector with identity tie-breaking, and applies one private set mutation. Views, virtual tables, triggers, foreign keys, generated columns, identity/unique-key updates, non-builtin PK collations, and conflict-sensitive forms remain mechanically gated.

parameterBindings.current: Exact SQLite ?/?NNN/named slot identity is signed; missing, extra, and conflicting values fail closed. Finite REAL inputs preserve exact IEEE 754 binary64 bits, including negative zero; NaN and infinities fail before publication.

scalarSubquery.current: Scalar subqueries require a syntactic at-most-one-row proof (no FROM or one VALUES row); catalog-dependent uniqueness proofs remain gated.

existsAndInSelect.current: Set-membership forms are supported when their nested SELECT passes every other gate.

limitOffset.current: A row-producing top-level SELECT LIMIT requires authored ORDER BY and canonical returned-column tie completion. Nested or unordered LIMIT is admitted only when the SELECT is syntactically at most one row; other row choices fail closed.

orderedResults.current: Authored outer ORDER BY is completed with every returned column under BINARY collation; an ordered mode without ORDER BY is rejected.

unorderedResults.current: Multiset and set rows are sorted by tagged canonical row CBOR; set mode removes exact duplicates.

unionAll.current: Supported subject to result ordering and nested-query gates.

jsonScalarFunctions.current: Only functions present in the closed deterministic function registry are admitted.

tableValuedFunctions.current: Only the approved pragma table functions are admitted.

explicitArgumentTimeFunctions.current: Arguments must be literal and may not be now/localtime/utc/subsec/subsecond; zero-argument and data-dependent calls are rejected.

protectedWrites.current: chronolog_, dolt_, doltlite_, pragma_, sqlite_, and protected virtual-table names fail in compiler and authorizer.

protectedReads.current: Only chronolog_transactions, sqlite_schema/sqlite_master, and approved pragma tables are readable.

sourceLimits.current: NUL, UTF-8, SQL byte length, SQLite category limits, VM steps, result columns/rows/value bytes, exact statement and transaction bytes, aggregate transaction rows, canonical sort work, and ordered target identity count/bytes/bindings are bounded.

operationalFailures.current: Operational SQLite primary codes abort replay; deterministic constraint/type/evaluation failures receive stable rejection codes and statement attribution.

resultEnvelope.bodyResults: SELECT and read-only pragma rows are bounded; every DML RETURNING is a multiset; affected row counts and statement indices are committed.
resultEnvelope.rejectionAttribution: phase, precondition id/index, statement index, manifest-registered stable code, and nullable canonical SQL schema identities are persisted; rejected candidates have no result envelope.

knownTemporaryDebt: Exact SQLite 3.54 parser grammar remains unavailable; the pinned 3.53/3.54 compatibility boundary is measured by pnpm conformance:sqlite
Window and ordered aggregate peer/tie completion
Registered deterministic functions, collations, and virtual-table modules
